name: Cathédrale Engloutie
brief: An immense half-submerged gothic cathedral floor within the Haven siege: central broad dry nave of worn charcoal marble with faint violet and cold cyan inlays, four clear broad aisles from each border; remnants of ornate pillars, broken pointed arches and a little luminous deep water arranged solely at the outer margins and corners. Small fractured stained-glass reflections glow along the peripheral floor, distant iron reliquaries at the extreme rim. The central two thirds is empty continuous dry walkable stone with low decorative geometric inlay, no pillars, no raised platforms, no holes. Ominous sacred ruined architecture, subtle aquatic caustics, restrained lighting.
